verdict.rationale: Justworks documents only narrow, built-in automatic behaviors. A user can set the Xero integration to automatically sync invoices the day after processing, and the software designates recurring holidays automatically each year. There is no evidence of a general automation builder, triggers or rules, or agent-driven background workflows. Missing for 10: user-defined automation/workflow builder, scheduled or triggered custom tasks, API or agent-driven background execution, independent corroboration.
